mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward quarterly trend in GDPC1 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) signals robust demand growth, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 showing a sustained upward quarterly trend over the past 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising discount rates on equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in GDPC1 (demand) and FEDFUNDS (monetary) above their 5% quarterly and monthly baselines respectively signals a convergence of growth and easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS both rise >5% in their respective timeframes
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite both proxies rising above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in UNRATE below 4.5% in a late-cycle expansion signals weakening labor market conditions, prompting market anticipation of interest rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the late-cycle regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward quarterly trend in HOUST (thousands of units) indicating strengthening demand growth compresses discount rates on equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05) despite HOUST showing a sustained upward quarterly trend.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward movement in INDPRO (supply index) and GDPC1 (demand) above their 5% quarterly baselines signals robust demand-supply balance, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise >5% quarterly
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite both proxies rising above thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in UNRATE below 3% triggers expectations of aggressive interest rate hikes, tightening financial conditions, and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) when UNRATE falls below 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in CPIAUCSL below 245 in a post-shock recovery regime signals easing inflation pressures, prompting central bank rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) when CPIAUCSL falls below 245 in the post-shock regime.
